newsitem.title: USA: Electropharmacology to merge with Eurobiotech.
newsitem.headline: Electropharmacology to merge with Eurobiotech.

text.p: Electropharmacology Inc said Monday it executed a letter of intent to merge with Eurobiotech Group Inc, a biotechnology company.
The company said it will issue 9 million shares of its common stock to Eurobiotech stockholders, and warrants to buy 4.5 million shares of its common stock at an exercise price of $3.00 per share.
The warrants are exercisable during the period beginning 24 months and ending 48 months after the merger date.
As a condition to the proposed merger, the combined company will privately place about 2 million shares with a medical technology investment fund in exchange for $5 million cash investment.
Electropharmacology said its name will be changed to Eurobiotech Group Inc in the merger.

In addition, Electropharmacology stockholders will receive warrants to buy 2 million shares of its common stock on the same exercise terms provided the combined entity meets certain minimum sales revenues during fiscal years 1997 and 1998.
Eurobiotech is a privately held "technology incubator" company.
